paragraphs: R. Yehudah, son of the sister of R. [Yosi bar] Chanina: Bava Batra 139a, near the end; the same matter in Ketubot 49b, near the end. Jerusalem Gittin, HaNizzakin, halakhah 3, has that matter in a reading Heilprin takes to be a scribal error. He proposes R. Yudan, R. Yosi bar Chanina's sister's son, in R. Yosi bar Chanina's name. [The checked passage mentions the sister of R. Yosi bar Chanina and a transmission in R. Yosi son of R. Chagai’s name.] The end of Jerusalem Terumot has that attribution chain [in a different discussion, on small quantities of terumah].
